description: Na₃VO₄ crystallizes in the orthorhombic Pbca space group. There are three inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.28-2.50 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.32-2.83 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.36-3.00 Å. V is bonded in a tetrahedral geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of V-O bond distances ranging from 1.73-1.75 Å. There are four inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded to four Na and one V atom to form distorted edge-sharing ONa₄V square pyramids. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to five Na and one V atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to four Na and one V atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to three Na and one V atom.
